title: Configurations in Entity Framework Core
description: Learn to configure domain classes using Data Annotation attributes and Fluent API.

data.text: EF Core allows us to configure domain classes to customize the EF model to database mappings. This programming pattern is referred to as **Convention over Configuration**.
There are two ways to configure domain classes in EF Core:
Data Annotations are a simple attribute-based configuration method where .NET attributes are applied to domain classes and properties.

data.title: Data Annotation Attributes Example
data.content: Using attributes to configure entity mappings

data.text: Fluent API is based on a method chaining pattern where the result is formulated by chaining multiple method calls together. It provides more configuration options than data annotation attributes.

data.title: Precedence
data.text: Fluent API configurations have higher precedence than data annotation attributes.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Convention over Configuration pattern allows customization
Data Annotations use attributes for simple configuration
Fluent API uses method chaining for advanced configuration
Fluent API has higher precedence than Data Annotations
data.takeaway: Continue to the next lesson to learn Fluent API in detail.
